anatomy.alwaysNote: shared wires Koin (DI) + Navigation, which are always included; core/logging sets up Kermit logging, core/review asks for in-app reviews and core/about shows the version, legal links and licences in every project, core/update checks for app updates, core/image loads images with Coil.

core/network.note: Ktor HTTP client; Coil network images

core/database.note: DataStore persistence; with theming also the saved Light/Dark/System choice (DarkModeManager)

core/purchases.note: offer / purchase / restore API, RevenueCat KMP (Test Store key: replace before you ship)

core/room.note: Room KMP database (bundled SQLite): AppDatabase, DAOs, schemas/

core/api.note: the app's client models and routes for the backend API, checked by ApiContractTest

core/auth.note: Firebase sign-in (email, Google, Apple); the server client's token

feature/notes.note: Notes demo screen on Room (blank only; showcase uses Room for favorites)

feature/account.note: sign-in screens and the account (blank only)
